name: MINE (Continuous Depth MPI)
aliases: MINE: Towards Continuous Depth MPI with NeRF for Novel View Synthesis
definition: MINE is a method for novel view synthesis that reconstructs a scene using a continuous depth Multi-Plane Image (MPI) representation, allowing rendering of any target view via homography warping after a single encoder pass and a fixed number of decoder passes, independent of the number of target views.
